L34@P0: History
L35@P0: AZUR SPACE was founded in 1964 as part of the AEG-TELEFUNKEN
L36@P0: group, supporting aerospace design, engineering and manufacturing in
L37@P0: Germany. Located roughly 160 kilometers (100 miles) south of Frankfurt
L38@P0: International Airport (IATA: FRA) and 70 kilometers (45 miles) north of
L39@P0: Stuttgart Airport (IATA: STR). AZUR SPACE is conveniently located in the
L40@P0: heart of Heilbronn Germany industrial center, drawing on world-class
L41@P0: technology, talent and critical supply chain elements from around the
L42@P0: Heilbronn area, from
L43@P0: wider Germany and
L44@P0: Europe, and around
L45@P0: the world.
L46@P0: In 1965, NASA and the
L47@P0: German Ministry for
L48@P0: Scientific Research
L49@P0: initiated a cooperative space satellite project that would orbit
L50@P0: the first German scientific spacecraft to investigate Earth's
L51@P0: inner radiation belt as well as study solar particles and
L52@P0: aurorae. The mission was called “GRS-A”, an acronym for
L53@P0: "German Research Satellite - A". In 1968 "Azur" was chosen
L54@P0: as the name for the satellite. The first predecessor company
L55@P0: to AZUR SPACE had key components fly successfully on the
L56@P0: Azur launch, completing successfully all objectives of that 8-
L57@P0: month namesake mission.

L70@P1: AZUR SPACE | General Information
L71@P1: In 1982, AEG-Telefunken was reformed into Telefunken Electronic, which in 1988
L72@P1: was reorganized into Daimler-Chrysler Aerospace. In 1994 ASE (Angewandte
L73@P1: Solarenergie) was created. In 2000, RWE acquired the solar power group from ASE,
L74@P1: forming RWE Solar / RWE Space Solar Power. Then, in 2007, the name AZUR
L75@P1: SPACE was formally adopted as the name of the company in its transition to new
L76@P1: ownership within the Generali Group of Trieste, Italy. In November 2021, the 5N Plus Company of Montreal,
L77@P1: Canada (TSX: VNP.TO; OTC: FPLSF) completed the acquisition of AZUR SPACE. AZUR SPACE continues to
L78@P1: operate today as a wholly owned subsidiary within the 5N Plus family.
L79@P1: Highlights
L80@P1: ▪ Founded in 1964, more than 60 years ago
L81@P1: ▪ 100% on orbit mission success
L82@P1: ▪ > 6 MW of multi-junction power delivered
L83@P1: ▪ > 11 MW total power delivered since 1964
L84@P1: ▪ Space Qualified: ECSS, AIAA, EN9100 (AS9100D)
L85@P1: and ISO9001 plus ISO 14001 and ISO 45001
L86@P1: ▪ Operating 24/7 with more than 350 people
L87@P1: ▪ Wholly owned subsidiary of the 5N Plus Company
L88@P1: Location & Factory
L89@P1: Since 1964, AZUR SPACE has been located in Heilbronn,
L90@P1: Germany at the renowned Telefunken Technology Park. Our
L91@P1: home in Technology Park allows key supply chain elements to be
L92@P1: acquired, serviced and supported from within the fully secured
L93@P1: campus. The campus lies in the heart of the Heilbronn, only 10
L94@P1: minutes from the main train station near the beautiful Neckar river.
L95@P1: The AZUR SPACE
L96@P1: manufacturing facility
L97@P1: and related support
L98@P1: infrastructure is
L99@P1: consolidated in two
L100@P1: buildings, over 5
L101@P1: floors and more than 11,000 square meters, including in excess of
L102@P1: 4,000 m2 of state-of-the-art production clean room facilities.
L103@P1: Our Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition
L104@P1: (MOCVD) epitaxial growth fabrication work-center
L105@P1: houses one of the highest capacity space-qualified
L106@P1: and dedicated epi infrastructures in the world. The
L107@P1: downstream wafer processing, cell manufacturing
L108@P1: and testing facilities are equally capable, semiautomated and staffed with the most experienced
L109@P1: and trained associates. Our advanced assembly
L110@P1: areas are cutting edge with qualified people and
L111@P1: equipment.

L128@P2: AZUR SPACE | General Information
L129@P2: Throughout our factory, AZUR SPACE employs a substantial number of patent protected processes as well as
L130@P2: company and trade secret processes. These combine to enable the know-how to manufacture products which
L131@P2: have provided 100% mission success to the space power industry.
L132@P2: In a 2022 press release, AZUR SPACE announced our intention to
L133@P2: grow our capitalized infrastructure to enable a 30% capacity
L134@P2: throughput increase. In 2024, AZUR SPACE publicly confirmed the
L135@P2: over-realization of this effort, by adding more than 35% to our
L136@P2: previously established capacity base. AZUR SPACE regularly
L137@P2: assesses the need for further capacity expansions.
L138@P2: AZUR SPACE has achieved the
L139@P2: Technology Readiness Level (TRL)
L140@P2: assessment of level 9 on the EASA /
L141@P2: NASA scale (9 being the highest),
L142@P2: including the required two years on
L143@P2: orbit without issue or anomaly. This
L144@P2: TRL assessment applies to all AZUR SPACE aerospace products, with the singular
L145@P2: exception of our newest 4G32-Advanced product variation, which is currently
L146@P2: completing formal qualification (currently assessed as TRL of 7). Similarly, AZUR
L147@P2: SPACE Manufacturing Readiness Level (“MRL”, as developed by the US
L148@P2: Department of Defense (DoD)) as a quantitative measure to assess the maturity of
L149@P2: high-volume manufacturing readiness has also been completed. The assessment
L150@P2: earned by AZUR SPACE is graded as highly mature, earning the maximum score
L151@P2: possible of 10, being most mature.
L152@P2: EMPLOYEE HIGHLIGHTS
L153@P2: The average age of an AZUR SPACE employee, as of this publication’s release date is 42 years old, with over 9
L154@P2: years of experience at AZUR SPACE. This population of experienced and well-trained people reflects a 55% /
L155@P2: 45% male/female ratio. Our employee population includes nearly 8% holding Ph.D. degrees, with an additional
L156@P2: 15% holding master’s degrees as their highest university degree. An additional almost 40% of AZUR SPACE’s
L157@P2: employee population holds bachelor’s degrees as their highest university level of degree. Finally, another 35%
L158@P2: have completed specialized, directly applicable technical training, above and beyond the normal training required
L159@P2: for each employee in their individual work center roles.
L160@P2: All AZUR SPACE employees are required and expected to complete relevant company, technical and / or job
L161@P2: specific training on a regular basis. The completion of these training requirements is actively planned, monitored
L162@P2-3: and tracked to ensure our workforce is prepared and certified as required.Issue date: 08-Apr-2025

L186@P3: ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH & SAFETY
L187@P3: COMMITMENT
L188@P3: AZUR SPACE’ commitment to Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) is to provide an
L189@P3: environmentally sound, healthy and injury-free workplace for all our employees, contractors,
L190@P3: customers, suppliers, communities and partners. We are routinely assessing and improving our
L191@P3: EH&S programs and training scope to increase our focus on enhancement, prevention, early
L192@P3: intervention and a culture of environmentally friendly, lifestyle-positive and safe workspaces. We
L193@P3: continually strive to enhance our EH&S implementation into our daily businesses and to encourage responsibility
L194@P3: for our own and others’ safety. As part of our ongoing ISO 45001:2018 certification, we take EH&S seriously by
L195@P3: striving to be a global leader in sustainability and environmental protection to enable our customers and others to
L196@P3: reduce their environmental impact through our actions, and by continuously reexamining our processes,
L197@P3: procedures, materials and technology. We routinely identify key environmental aspects of our operations,
L198@P3: mitigating impacts and enhancing our use of circular economy principles (reducing, reusing and recycling).
L199@P3: AZUR SPACE also adheres to the
L200@P3: European Sustainability Reporting
L201@P3: Standard (ESRS) and continuously
L202@P3: strives to meet the objectives of our
L203@P3: environmental stewardship as well as our
L204@P3: social responsibilities as embodied in
L205@P3: ESRS purposes.
L206@P3: AZUR SPACE also follows the Carbon
L207@P3: Disclosure Project (CDP) organization
L208@P3: standards and guidelines in our
L209@P3: continued efforts to understand,
L210@P3: measure, manage and report our
L211@P3: environmental impacts with targets to
L212@P3: reduce the overall AZUR SPACE carbon
L213@P3: footprint.

L240@P4: COMMITMENT TO QUALITY
L241@P4: To ensure AZUR SPACE maximizes the value proposition, we are fully committed to embracing quality as an

L244@P4: procedures that incorporate and embrace quality.
L245@P4: Our products have been exceeding our
L246@P4: customers' highest standards of quality and
L247@P4: reliability for decades. We supply international
L248@P4: space projects such as communication
L249@P4: satellites and scientific space missions and
L250@P4: also serve other global markets, for example in
L251@P4: the field of renewable energies. With deliveries

L254@P4: we strive to only improve this success.

L261@P4: and place the utmost trust in us when it comes
L262@P4: to the promised delivery, reliability
L263@P4: and quality of our products.

L332@P5: STANDARD CONFIGURATION PRODUCTS
L333@P5: AZUR SPACE manufactures space grade Germanium (Ge) and IIIV semiconductor based solar cells and assemblies (including
L334@P5: Silicon bypass diodes). These technologies are primarily 3G30-
L335@P5: Advanced (Triple Junction, “TJ”) and 4G32-Advanced (Quadruple
L336@P5: Junction, “QJ”) class devices. Heritage Silicon cell manufacturing
L337@P5: was phased out in the early 2010’s as the power density and cost
L338@P5: per watt value propositions of Silicon solar cells no longer aligned
L339@P5: with our space customers’ market expectations or demands.
L340@P5: At www.azurspace.com, the following standard product data sheets
L341@P5: can be found and downloaded. These devices are considered our
L342@P5: standard product configurations and may be ordered directly by part
L343@P5: number. These parts all have existing drawings and documentation available. Although other sizes and
L344@P5: configurations are available, these standard products represent best value in the marketplace and have significant
L345@P5: production and flight heritage. The typical technical information for the cell-interconnected-coverglassed (CIC)
L346@P5: assembly and its subassembly solar cell device, are included in the same data sheet.
L347@P5: Each of these standard part configurations comes in a defined product thickness as specified in the corresponding
L348@P5: data sheet. It is possible to modify the thickness of the base Germanium (Ge) substrate, resulting in a thinner or
L349@P5: thicker device driving mass and value as required by the specific mission. Reduction in product thickness is the
L350@P5: result of additional processing to reduce the remaining Ge substrate. This mass management effort may result in
L351@P5: additional processing which may result in additional costs being incurred and reflected in unit pricing relative to
L352@P5-6: the standard products. AZUR SPACE can provide estimates as to specific Ge mass reductions upon request. Issue date: 08-Apr-2025

L429@P6: CUSTOM CONFIGURATION PRODUCTS
L430@P6: In the event that the standard sizes reflected in the above standard data sheets do not support the intended

AZUR SPACE’s 3G30-Advanced bare solar cells and solar cell assemblies (“SCA”), or CICs (Cell-interconnect-
coverglass) are the ideal solution for space power applications in conventional or in New Space segments.  The 
award-winning 3G30-Advanced technology design offers proven best-in-class end-of-life (EOL) performance at 
lowest Cost-per-Watt, enabling a multitude of heritage options for all orbits and missions. 
SPACE  |  3G30-Advanced (4x8)
The 3G30C bare cell device is a space-qualified InGaP/GaAs/Ge triple-junction solar cell originating from a 
100 mm germanium (Ge) substrate and provides 30% class beginning-of-life (BOL) efficiency.  This device 
includes AZUR SPACE’s proprietary radiation-hardened design for best EOL performance.  Our standard cell 
features well-proven metallization as well as an improved busbar and grid-design with two contact pads plus one 
for a discrete bypass diode connection and a standard cell size of 30.18 cm² (4 cm x 8 cm, or “4x8”).  This 
configuration offers a bare cell total thickness of 150 µm.  The 3G30C solar cell is compatible with an external 
bypass diode, which is also available from AZUR SPACE together with bare cell orders.   
The 3G30A assembly includes a bare 3G30C solar cell, a corner-mounted silicon bypass diode, welded out-of-
plane silver-coated Kovar interconnectors (“ICs”) and a 100 µm AR coated coverglass bonded with space-grade 
adhesive.  This assembly has a standard size of 31.13 cm² (glass size) and has a device thickness of 290 µm.  A 
digital CAD / CAM STEP file as well as digital device photographs of a bare cell or assembly are available upon 
request. 
Other non-standard sizes, thicknesses and configurations are also available upon request.  Thickness and mass 
values and variations of the above standard devices are shown below. 
The 3G30 Advanced technology, cells and assemblies are ECSS-E-ST-20-08C (Rev. 1) qualified.  These devices 
are all produced in our mature MRL-10 Heilbronn facility.  Our technology and products have demonstrated on-
orbit TRL-9 level heritage.  AZUR SPACE is certified to ISO 9001:2015 (QMS), EN 9100:2018 (QMS, European 
equivalent to AS 9100D), as well as ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental) and ISO 45001:2018 (Health & Safety).

L11@P0: AZUR SPACE Product Naming Information
L12@P0: AZUR SPACE space solar devices follow a logical and informative combination of variables to provide
L13@P0: information relevant to decision makers understanding the differences between standard products. AZUR
L14@P0: SPACE technologies are representatively named like:
L15@P0: These product technology descriptions break into up to four discrete elements of the technology. To aid in
L16@P0: understanding what this means, these product technology titles are repeated and separated into up to four
L17@P0: separate parts:
L18@P0: Each position (designated 1 – 4 above) in these product names can be better understood as follows:
L19@P0: 1) The #1 position reflects the AZUR SPACE technology generation or number of junctions in the MOCVD
L20@P0: growth in the EPI wafer. For example 3G ion the first title position indicates 3rd Generation, or a Triple
L21@P0: Junction technology. Alternatively, 4G in the 1st title position represents 4th Generation, Quadruple
L22@P0: junction or “Four Junction” device.
L23@P0: 2) The #2 position in the title reflects the Beginning of Life (BOL) efficiency family as derived from a 4x8
L24@P0: device from a 100mm Germanium wafer. This position typically shows a “27” (27% family), “28” (28%
L25@P0: family), “30” (30% family) or “32” (32% family).
L26@P0: 3) The #3 position indicates the AZUR SPACE product configuration. “C” means “Cell” or a Bare Cell
L27@P0: configuration. Alternatively, “A” means an Assembly (CIC or SCA). Be advised there may or may not be
L28@P0: a “-“ after the C or A in documentation.
L29@P0: 4) The #4 position of the product title indicates the evolution of the technology. If this #4th position is blank
L30@P0: (i.e., nothing follows “C” or “A”), then this is the baseline, original qualification of this 3G or 4G
L31@P0: technology. If “Advanced” (or “Adv.”) is in this position, this technology is newer than the initial baseline
L32@P0: qualification, and is the most current generation, updating the baseline through a subsequent
L33@P0: qualification and engineering verification cycle.
L34@P0: AZUR SPACE standard space technologies and component products have demonstrated to an in-orbit TRL-9
L35@P0: level heritage and an MRL-10 maturity designation. AZUR SPACE is certified to ISO 9001:2015 (Quality
L36@P0: Management System (QMS)), EN 9100:2018 (QMS, USA equivalent to AS 9100D and Asian equivalent to JISQ
L37@P0: 9100:2016), as well as ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management System) and EN ISO 45001:2023
L38@P0: (Occupational Health & Safety).
L39@P0: Please refer to the AZUR SPACE General Information Sheet for additional information including in-orbit
L40@P0: heritage, quality certifications, business licenses, product registrations and general company information at
